topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe you found that time capsule! I mean, how wild is that? It’s like a mystery from the past, and I’m just thinking about all the stuff that could be inside. What did you find? I know it’s probably nothing, just some old letters or trinkets, but still, it’s so cool. I wish I was there to see your face when you opened it. I should have told you about the time we accidentally buried some of our stuff, thinking it was a fun idea. Anyway, tell me everything! I’m right here, and I want to know all the details.
